9to5Mac Daily is recorded fresh every weekday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast platform to get each new episode as soon as it drops.

News stories discussed in this episode:

  • [Report] Apple is developing a new version of Vision Pro and is considering a different form factor
  • [Leak] Latest leaked documents reveal details about the next-generation iPad mini
  • [Leaked images] Next-generation Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini surface
  • Apple has been found to infringe on a Taptic Engine patent and ordered to pay US$5.7 billion in damages
